ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2008-12-31..2026-06-30; paid FY facts for 6 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no declared FY fact and no four declared quarterly facts (2012-12-31, 2013-12-31, 2014-12-31, 2015-12-31, 2016-12-31, 2017-12-31); the declared tag files quarterly facts in the last 8 quarters ending 2026-06-30, the paid tag only full-year facts — the quarterly tag is primary (the paid tag's full-year facts fill only fiscal years the declared tag does not cover)
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

buybacks.basis: not filed for any of the four quarters

share_issuance.basis: 3/4 quarters covered (the six-month year-to-date fact 2026-01-01..2026-06-30 = 166.3M (ProceedsFromIssuanceOrSaleOfEquity, filed 2026-07-30) + the filed quarters 2025-09-30) — a lower bound
left_out: quarter ended 2025-12-31: the year-to-date facts decrease (2025-01-01..2025-09-30 = 606,810,000 > 2025-01-01..2025-12-31 = 606,768,000) — no quarter can be derived from them (the quarterly row read -42,000; typically a line tagged in one filing and not in the next); left out (a missing quarter)

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters) − share_issuance (3/4 quarters covered (the six-month year-to-date fact 2026-01-01..2026-06-30 = 166.3M (ProceedsFromIssuanceOrSaleOfEquity, filed 2026-07-30) + the filed quarters 2025-09-30) — a lower bound); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 2.68 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.67, 2026-06-30: 0.67) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.67, 2025-06-30: 0.67)
buybacks_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed buybacks figure (missing 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30)
